freshman.label: First-Time Student
freshman.intro: Fresh out of high school (or finishing your equivalency)? Here's your six-step path from application to your first class.
fit: You're a graduating high school senior
You're attending college for the first time
You've earned PCC credits through Career & College Promise

steps.title: Apply to PCC — it's free
steps.desc: Complete the online application through CFNC and the NC Residency Determination Service. It takes about 20 minutes and there's no application fee.

steps.title: Complete the FAFSA
steps.desc: File the FAFSA and add PCC as a recipient. Most PCC students qualify for grants or scholarships — many attend tuition-free.

steps.title: Send your transcripts
steps.desc: Have your high school (or GED/HiSET) transcript sent to Admissions & Records. Unofficial copies can get you started.

steps.title: Complete placement
steps.desc: Most students place using their high school GPA — no test needed. Otherwise, the free RISE assessment is available on campus.

steps.title: Attend New Student Orientation
steps.desc: Meet your advisor, tour campus, set up your myPittCC account and learn how registration works.

steps.title: Register for classes
steps.desc: Work with your advisor in the Central Advising Center to build a schedule that fits your goals — and your life.

transfer.label: Transfer Student
transfer.intro: Coming from another college? We'll evaluate your credits so you don't repeat what you've already earned.
fit: You've attended another college or university since high school
You're returning to PCC after time away
You want prior credits evaluated so nothing is wasted

steps.title: Apply to PCC — it's free
steps.desc: Complete the online application and NC residency determination. No application fee, no test scores.

steps.title: Send all college transcripts
steps.desc: Request official transcripts from every college you've attended. Our team evaluates them for transfer credit.

steps.title: Complete the FAFSA
steps.desc: Financial aid follows you — add PCC as a recipient so your aid is ready when you are.

steps.title: Review your credit evaluation
steps.desc: Admissions & Records maps your prior credits to your PCC program so your path to finishing is clear.

steps.title: Meet your advisor and register
steps.desc: Your advisor builds a plan from where your credits leave off — no wasted courses, no wasted money.

adult.label: Adult Learner
adult.intro: Whether it's been two years or twenty, PCC is built for students balancing work, family and school.
fit: You've been out of school for a while and want a fresh start
You're balancing work or family alongside school
You need a credential that pays off quickly

steps.title: Talk with us first (optional, encouraged)
steps.desc: Not sure where to start? Connect with an advisor about career goals, short-term credentials and flexible formats before you apply.

steps.title: Apply to PCC — it's free
steps.desc: The online application takes about 20 minutes. Need your high school equivalency first? Our free Transitional Studies programs can get you there.

steps.title: Complete the FAFSA and explore workforce scholarships
steps.desc: Adult learners often qualify for aid they don't expect — including state scholarships that cover short-term workforce training.

steps.title: Get credit for what you already know
steps.desc: Work experience, military training and prior credentials may count toward your program through credit for prior learning.

steps.title: Pick a format that fits your life
steps.desc: Evening, online, hybrid and 8-week options let you keep working while you learn. Your advisor helps you build it.

steps.title: Register and start
steps.desc: Late-start classes begin several times each semester — you rarely have to wait long to begin.

highschool.label: High School Student
highschool.intro: Earn college credit — tuition-free — while you're still in high school through Career & College Promise.
fit: You're a North Carolina high school junior or senior
You have roughly a 2.8 unweighted GPA
You want tuition-free college credit before graduation

steps.title: Talk to your school counselor
steps.desc: Your counselor confirms your eligibility (typically an unweighted 2.8 GPA) and helps you choose a pathway.

steps.title: Choose your pathway
steps.desc: Pick a college transfer pathway toward a bachelor's degree, or a career & technical pathway toward a credential.

steps.title: Apply through Career & College Promise
steps.desc: Complete the CCP application with your counselor's sign-off. Tuition is waived for eligible students.

steps.title: Register with your PCC liaison
steps.desc: Our high school programs team schedules your classes around your school day.

steps.title: Start earning college credit
steps.desc: Credits count toward high school graduation and your future degree at the same time.
